## Summary of test results

The BS-synthetic Stage-1 run (proxy for real-fills) shows edge_capture = 759.21 on J anchor days, which is below the OP-16 floor of 771 (50% of max possible 1542). Winner days 4/29 and 5/01 produced losses (-$23.95, -$21.56) instead of the required profits (+$342, +$470). Winner day 5/04 produced $804.72 (vs required +$730). Loser days showed no engine losses (5/05: $0, 5/06: $0, 5/07: +$74.29 profit), so no penalty was incurred. The wide_pnl was -$1,464.23 over 225 trades (18.7% WR). The test did not validate real-fills; it used BS-synthetic pricing.

## Mechanism

The test evaluates the QQQ_DIVERGENCE_CONFLUENCE_FIRSTPASS strategy logic over historical SPY/VIX bars using Black-Scholes synthetic option pricing (not real OPRA fills). It computes P&L per day based on the strategy's entry/exit rules.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** The test uses abstract P&L units; real-fills would require $25K+ account for full position sizing (per BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON rules). $1K paper ≈ 14% headline P&L.
2. **Sample bias:** Test ran over 2025-Q1 to 2026-Q2 (6 months). Selection: all days where strategy logic triggered. Overfit risk: high due to no OOS/WF validation and concentration in 2026-Q1 (see below).
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no walk-forward held-out window performed in this test).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (test used BS-synthetic pricing; real OPRA fills not validated).
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: 2025-Q1 (-$1,300.50) 
   - Max drawdown: $4,701.52 
   - Blow-up scenario: persistent low-VIX regimes (2025-Q3: -$1,134.66) where strategy fails to capture winners and incurs losses on loser days.
6. **Concentration:** Top 5 days = 999.0% of P&L (indicating extreme concentration; top day 2026-Q1: $1,548.89 alone exceeds total P&L). Top-5 days drive 100%+ of P&L, leaving other days net-negative.

## Pre-merge gate

To pass the fundable real-fills replay gate, the strategy must:
1. Achieve edge_capture ≥ 771 on J anchor days in real-fills validation.
2. Pass real-fills validation on top 3 J days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) with < ±20% deviation from BS-synthetic proxy.
3. Demonstrate OOS/WF stability (WF ≥ 0.70) and positive quarters ≥ 4/6.
4. Show concentration mitigation (top5_pct ≤ 200%).
5. Clear gym validators and walk-forward tests.

3 / 10 -- Low confidence due to BS-synthetic proxy (not real-fills), extreme concentration, and failure to capture J winner days 4/29 and 5/01. Real-fills validation likely to show worse performance due to slippage on low-priced 0DTE options.
